name: Almost no evidence exists, so confidence must stay low
description: A pre-seed deck with no revenue, a one-line market claim, and a corpus containing a single source that explicitly says no reliable sizing estimate exists. The correct behaviour is to say so and keep confidence low. Confidently sizing this market would be the failure — this case exists to catch overclaiming on absent evidence, which is the most damaging thing a diligence tool can do.
